title: DR House
description:
A white volume, defined by stone buttresses and strategically carved openings, creates a composition shaped by absence,clear frames set within darker surfaces. 

This three-bedroom house, adapted to a plot in Coimbra, subtly integrates into its surroundings, featuring large south-facing balconies. The house follows the Passive House thermal principles, where the balcony overhangs play a crucial role, not only in thermal performance but also in the overall aesthetic expression. 

The structure reveals a reinforced concrete frame system, combined with hollow block masonry infill
